scoring_contract.warning: Implementation coverage is not acceptance. A criterion passes only with its proposal-level evidence.

criteria.proposal_criterion: >=100 hours with turn boundaries and overlap labels
criteria.gap: Quantity and machine integrity pass; turn/overlap labels are automatic and listening QA is waived.

criteria.proposal_criterion: fine-tuned direct S2S model with reduced loss and intelligible Persian output
criteria.gap: Moshika training produced a positive loss signal, but every direct runtime candidate failed and no adapter was promoted.

criteria.proposal_criterion: qualifying <=500 ms end-to-end latency on one 12-24 GB GPU
criteria.gap: Streaming transport exists, but no physical target/browser rows establish mean, p90, or maximum latency.

criteria.proposal_criterion: >=0.80 interrupt F1 plus <=150 ms stop/adaptation behavior
criteria.gap: The automatic-label proxy has 0.8106 accuracy but only 0.7899 F1; independent labels and physical <=150 ms traces are absent.

criteria.proposal_criterion: MOS >=3.5 from 5-10 Persian speakers including >=2 aged 60+
criteria.gap: Study tooling exists, but there are zero complete ratings and no qualifying MOS or elderly finding.

proposal_internal_ambiguities: The problem statement binds p90 latency, the objective table binds average latency, and neither defines the timing endpoints.
The detector objective says accuracy >=80% while labeling the criterion F1; accuracy and F1 are not interchangeable.
The final note allows an undergraduate project to prioritize latency or full duplex, but no filled or signed scope choice is present.
